requirements.invariant: A crash/interruption never directly converts work to terminal failed or completed.
Every interruption creates or deduplicates one durable InterruptionObservation with source evidence.
Heartbeat/lease loss is interruption evidence only, never proof of domain failure.
Interrupted work is classified before resumption unless a preauthorized deterministic class applies; critical evidence gaps block or require manual decision.
Classification covers resume, reconcile-then-resume, restart-safe-boundary, restart-beginning, wait-dependency, migrate, old-runtime, manual, quarantine and terminal outcomes.
RecoveryPlan binds the exact classification, checkpoint/effect evidence, compatibility, authority and verification criteria used to authorize resume; changed inputs require replan.
